views.markdown: PanoramaPages turns Home Screen pages into windows onto one continuous image. Choose a wide photo in Settings and it moves smoothly as you swipe.

- Select, replace, or remove a dedicated panorama
- Tune image span and direction without a respring
- Keeps the effect behind icons and outside the Lock Screen
- Optional LiquidAss Snapshot compatibility on validated systems
- Includes arm64 and arm64e slices
**iOS 26 is installable but has not been device-tested.** iOS 18 and later require a selected custom panorama; the private system-wallpaper fallback stays disabled.

### 0.3.0

- Unified the validated iOS 18 path into the standard rootless package.
- Allowed rootless installation through iOS 26, with iOS 26 clearly marked untested.
- Added Settings and Sileo artwork plus native package details.
- Kept the iOS 18+ system-wallpaper fallback disabled; select a custom panorama instead.
